about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of a curious child and explore sprawling haunted mansions in this cooperative VR horror adventure. Each session begins in a lively shared hub, where you gather with friends or new allies before venturing into eerie, multi-level houses brimming with mystery. Your goal: collect valuable treasures, solve strange puzzles, and survive the supernatural dangers within.

Every mansion has its own haunting—monsters with unique behaviors, environmental hazards, and secrets to uncover. From dolls that stalk you when you’re alone, to creatures that lurk in mirrors, each encounter forces you to think, hide, and act together. The child’s-eye view heightens the sense of wonder and fear, bringing everyday objects to towering, ominous scale.

No two runs are the same—treasures change, monsters adapt, and secret areas hide behind riddles and relics. Earn playful cosmetic rewards to show off in the hub, but remember: nothing you carry in will survive the night if you don’t make it out.

With its eerie atmosphere, whimsical yet unsettling art style, and emphasis on cooperation, this is more than a haunted house game—it’s a shared ghost story you live together.

name: One By One

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2/3/Pro, Valve Index, HTC Vive
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • Storage: 30 MB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2/3/Pro, Valve Index, HTC Vive

short_description: A cooperative VR horror adventure where you explore haunted mansions as a child, outsmart unique monsters, solve puzzles, and uncover treasures in a spooky, story-rich world.
